column1: # Model codes returned in the second field of an 0101 Read Type Name response
# (2 bytes little-endian in binary, 4 hex characters in ASCII).
# connect()'s identify step compares this code against the profile the caller declared
# and raises SlmpProfileMismatchError when it is not in the profile's set. There is no
# generic profile and no radix guess, so a model code that is absent from this table is
# an error the user resolves with `aslmp identify`, never a fallback.
# profile_key is empty for a code that identifies a FAMILY rather than a model
# (0x0360 RCPU): no profile may claim it.

column15: Catch-all returned when the connected station is not an iQ-R or MX module and an RCPU is read. It identifies a family, not a model, so no profile may claim it: connect() must raise SlmpProfileMismatchError.
